390px saved title: scene, Continue, real journey/chapter/location, party portraits and secondary actions fit coherently and remain readable.
390px travel ledger: compact flat roster, current HP/MP and Poisoned condition, clear eight-command rail, sticky close and reachable final traveler.
Desktop and short-landscape ledger/return views retain useful controls and clear foreground text.
notes: Every final preview boot and reload verifies exact served bytes against this game hash; final run did not route a private candidate over the preview.
Fixtures are genuine engine-generated saved states. They declare levels, access and resources for bounded QA; they are not a complete earned campaign or universal balance playthrough.
Actual UI performs creation, menu navigation, purchases, healing and combat. window.__AVEL__ is used only for snapshot/map/viewport reads; no runtime mutation API was added.
Moon alpha is sampled by drawing the actual serialized visible moon and mask into a detached local canvas; full title screenshots were visually reviewed separately.
Baseline diagnostics found only a test locator ambiguity (two intentional creator Cancel buttons); the selector was scoped before the final run.
